news_headlines.summary: Western Digital (NasdaqGS:WDC) has appointed Manuvir Das, an AI veteran with experience from NVIDIA, Dell EMC, and Microsoft, to its board of directors. This strategic appointment aims to enhance Western Digital's capabilities in AI infrastructure and cloud-scale storage, aligning with the growing demand for high-capacity, high-performance storage driven by AI and large language models. news_headlines.title: Pentagon awards Microsoft $9.7B deal to consolidate software licenses across military branches
news_headlines.summary: The US Department of Defense has awarded Dell Federal Systems a five-year, $9.7 billion contract to consolidate Microsoft software licensing across the military, intelligence community, and Coast Guard. This Core Enterprise Technology Agreement (CETA) aims to eliminate duplicate purchases and generate $422 million in annual savings. Dell will manage the logistics and compliance, while Microsoft provides the software, highlighting Microsoft's continued dominance in government IT.

(NASDAQ: OESX) has launched a new energy-efficient LED lighting solution, the MPHL2, specifically targeting the rapidly growing AI-driven data center market. Data centers require highly efficient solutions due to their immense energy consumption, and Orion's new product aims to provide significant energy savings and customization options. The company sees this as a long-term market opportunity, capitalizing on the projected thousands of new data centers being built in the coming years.

news_headlines.title: IREN Limited signs $1.6B deal with Dell for AI cloud systems

This new agreement adds to previous multi-billion-dollar hardware purchases from Dell and is anchored by a nearly $10 billion contract with Microsoft for AI infrastructure. The company plans to build a fleet of approximately 150,000 GPU units and has secured over 4.5 GW of renewable power capacity for its data centers.
